findings.title: Turbo token exposed to same-repo PR code

validation.rationale: Maintained pull_request workflow jobs still expose Turbo credentials to same-repo PR code paths that run checked-out local actions and repo commands. The affected workflow is maintained code, not .repos.

remediation.summary: Limited Turbo and app secrets to trusted push contexts and forced pull-request cache behavior to local mode.

findings.remediationHint: Restrict Turbo credentials to trusted events or otherwise ensure PR-controlled code cannot read inherited Turbo secrets.

findings.title: Host header controls TLS SNI and certificate identity

validation.rationale: The captured finding targets an external checkout under .repos and no matching maintained source pattern was found outside .repos. Per packet policy, .repos findings are out of scope.

findings.remediationHint: No maintained-code remediation. Close in Codex as false positive.

findings.title: DataMoat plugin installs code that captures local AI histories

validation.rationale: The tracked plugin marketplace advertises a local DataMoat plugin with install/run scripts and broad agent permissions. Those maintained plugin files are in scope and not under .repos.

remediation.summary: Removed the installable DataMoat marketplace entry and plugin payload from tracked agent plugin surfaces.

findings.remediationHint: Remove the installable DataMoat plugin entry and plugin files, or replace them with a non-installing documentation-only surface that cannot start background capture from agent scripts.

findings.title: Event-log RPC trusts client-supplied public keys

validation.rationale: The reported RPC implementation files exist only under .repos/effect-v4 and are outside maintained beep-effect code. Maintained matches do not expose the reported remote server path.

findings.remediationHint: No maintained-code remediation. Close in Codex as false positive.

findings.title: Signing key is read before release approval

validation.rationale: The desktop release preflight still maps the updater signing secret before the protected approval environment gate. The updater public-key config makes the signing key security-sensitive for the update channel.

remediation.summary: Moved signing secret validation behind the protected desktop release environment.

findings.remediationHint: Keep preflight non-secret and move signing-secret presence checks behind the protected release approval gate.

findings.title: Unescaped upstream data can inject generated TypeScript
findings.ownerArea: repo-cli SyncDataToTs data generation and data-sync workflow

validation.rationale: Maintained SyncDataToTs renderers interpolate upstream metadata into generated TypeScript block comments without a comment-safe formatter. The scheduled data-sync workflow imports generated output during checks/tests.

remediation.summary: Escaped upstream metadata before rendering generated TypeScript comments and added hostile metadata coverage.

findings.remediationHint: Add and apply a block-comment-safe metadata formatter, then add a regression test for hostile metadata in generated headers.

findings.title: Workflow dispatch input enables shell injection

validation.rationale: The maintained workflow expands a manual dispatch input directly inside a bash run step without strict numeric validation or safe environment handoff. The job has issue write access and CI secrets context, so command execution has meaningful impact.

remediation.summary: Moved manual run count input through an environment variable and validated it as a bounded positive integer before shell use.

findings.remediationHint: Move the dispatch value into an environment variable, validate it as a positive integer, and pass only the validated value to the property sweep command.

findings.title: Research daily can commit raw browser history on scan failure

validation.rationale: Maintained research code copies a browser history database into a vault-local scratch directory, removes it only on successful scanning, continues daily work after failures, and commit mode stages broadly. Timer setup enables commit mode by default.

remediation.summary: Copied browser history into scoped temporary storage and kept research commits from staging raw .beep artifacts.

findings.remediationHint: Ensure history scratch copies are cleaned with acquire/release or ensuring, keep transient state outside versioned commits, and stage only an allowlist of generated artifacts.

findings.title: Unbounded event-log chunk reassembly enables DoS

validation.rationale: The reported event-log chunk reassembly implementation exists only under .repos/effect-v4. Searches outside .repos found no maintained server implementation exposing the reported code path.

findings.remediationHint: No maintained-code remediation. Close in Codex as false positive.

findings.title: Tier gate permits non-read-only writes without approval

validation.rationale: The maintained tier gate automatically approves any tool whose destructive annotation is false without also requiring a read-only annotation. Non-read-only additive/idempotent writes can therefore bypass explicit policy approval.

remediation.summary: Required readonly tool annotations before non-destructive auto-approval can bypass approval.

findings.remediationHint: Automatically approve only read-only and non-destructive tools; require explicit policy approval for all non-read-only or destructive tools, with a regression test.

findings.title: Broad gitleaks allowlist disables secret scanning

validation.rationale: The maintained gitleaks config globally allows research SOURCES.md paths without rule scoping, suppressing all rule matches in those files. CI, local quality, and pre-commit lanes consume that config.

remediation.summary: Scoped the research allowlist to the generic API-key rule instead of disabling broad secret scanning.

findings.remediationHint: Scope the SOURCES.md allowlist to the intended rule, such as generic-api-key, while preserving anchored path patterns.

findings.title: Remote skill updater allows path traversal writes

validation.rationale: The maintained remote skill updater derives local write paths from remote entry paths using prefix checks and path joins without rejecting traversal or proving resolved containment. The root package exposes the write-mode updater.

remediation.summary: Rejected traversal and out-of-root paths from GitHub skill tree entries before writing updates.

findings.remediationHint: Normalize and validate every remote path before fetch/write, reject absolute/traversal/special segments, and assert resolved destinations remain inside the canonical skill directory.

findings.title: N3 writer allows RDF injection via unescaped IRIs
findings.ownerArea: external N3 dependency / ignored research checkout

validation.rationale: The reported root N3 implementation files are not tracked maintained repo files. Matching files exist only in ignored dependency installs or out-of-scope research checkouts, and maintained packages/apps do not import n3.

findings.remediationHint: No maintained-code remediation. Close in Codex as false positive.

findings.title: Desktop signing job no longer uses protected environment

validation.rationale: The maintained desktop release workflow attaches the protected environment only to an approval placeholder job while signing and release-writing jobs run without the protected environment. A needs dependency orders jobs but does not make dependents protected.

remediation.summary: Restored protected-environment gating for desktop release signing and readiness.

findings.remediationHint: Attach the protected environment to every job that reads signing credentials or stages release assets, or move signing/upload work into the protected job.

findings.title: Office actions sent to LLM provider without a guard

validation.rationale: The office-action review path sends full extracted document text through LangExtract and the injected LanguageModel path. The live law-practice layer can use remote provider layers and no local-only, consent, redaction, classification, or policy guard was found.

remediation.summary: Added a default-deny remote extraction policy and wired law-practice server config to opt into remote LangExtract use.

findings.remediationHint: Fail closed before extraction unless policy permits the selected provider and data class; add local/remote provider capability checks and tenant/user opt-in or redaction.

findings.title: Committed SkillOpt artifacts leak local filesystem paths

validation.rationale: Tracked SkillOpt generated history under goals still contains absolute developer-machine paths and execution metadata. The affected paths are not under .repos and a targeted secret-pattern check did not find direct secrets.

remediation.summary: Removed tracked generated SkillOpt run outputs and scrubbed remaining local filesystem paths from retained findings/proofs.

findings.remediationHint: Remove or regenerate the committed generated history with local paths and execution traces scrubbed, and add ignore/export sanitation for future SkillOpt artifacts.

findings.title: Unsafe Turtle IRI formatting permits RDF injection

validation.rationale: The public identity helper validates the local name but directly interpolates caller-provided prefix or full IRI into Turtle output. The helper is re-exported from maintained package code.

remediation.summary: Validated PN_LOCAL prefixes and percent-encoded unsafe full IRI references before rendering.

findings.remediationHint: Validate prefix and full IRI emission rules or accept branded validated values; add regression tests for delimiter, quote, backslash, and control-character rejection.

findings.title: Unsafe deepMerge permits prototype poisoning

validation.rationale: The exported deepMerge helper clones into an ordinary object and assigns patch entries directly. A blocked-key guard exists nearby but is not applied in deepMerge.

remediation.summary: Skipped blocked object keys during deep merge and covered prototype-pollution inputs.

findings.remediationHint: Reject prototype-sensitive property names during recursive merge and add tests for top-level and nested hostile patch keys.

findings.title: Dynamic heading level enables HTML injection

validation.rationale: Maintained HTML render paths build heading tags from runtime heading level data without schema-decoding the public render boundary. Malformed in-memory documents can alter the trusted HtmlFragment output at the library/API boundary.

remediation.summary: Validated heading levels through the schema guard and fell back to h6 for forged values.

findings.remediationHint: Render headings through a closed 1..6 mapping or validate Document/Block at public HTML render boundaries, with regression coverage.

findings.title: Predictable /tmp inspector script path enables local code execution

validation.rationale: The referenced generator is absent from current HEAD, no .repos/node-types checkout is present, and tracked source no longer contains the relevant inspector helper symbols. The current snapshot is already fixed.

findings.remediationHint: No current remediation. If reintroduced, use private mkdtemp directories and avoid executing helpers from shared temp paths.

findings.title: Schema.Void now accepts arbitrary input

validation.rationale: The reported behavior is in vendored Effect files under .repos or dependency copies, not first-party maintained source. Maintained RPC declarations inspected provide explicit payload schemas and do not rely on the reported default.

findings.remediationHint: No maintained-code remediation. Close in Codex as false positive.

findings.title: Attachment size limit bypasses upload callback

validation.rationale: Picker and drag/drop/paste flows route raw File arrays into captureAttachmentsFn, which invokes onAttach before applying maxAttachmentBytes. Oversized files can reach the upload callback despite being rejected from local state.

remediation.summary: Filtered oversized attachments before invoking callbacks and kept IME composition guards intact.

findings.remediationHint: Filter/decode files against maxAttachmentBytes before invoking onAttach, or change the callback contract to accepted attachments plus rejections, with regression coverage.

findings.title: Developer-local paths committed in research prompt

validation.rationale: The maintained seed prompt still contains multiple absolute developer-local links. The file is under goals and not covered by the .repos out-of-scope rule.

remediation.summary: Replaced developer-local checkout paths in the research seed prompt with generic placeholders.

findings.remediationHint: Replace absolute developer-machine links with repo-relative references, public upstream URLs, or sanitized placeholders.

findings.title: Internal Tailnet service URL leaked in README

validation.rationale: A tracked exploration README still contains a concrete internal Tailnet service URL, while adjacent files mention Tailnet only generically.

remediation.summary: Redacted the internal Tailnet service URL from the exploration README.

findings.remediationHint: Remove the concrete internal URL and replace it with a generic private deployment placeholder.

findings.title: Claim gate admits claims with fabricated evidence spans

validation.rationale: Maintained claim/evidence admission allows nonnegative but unordered offsets and arbitrary quote text, and the ClaimGate validation only checks for one typed quote triple rather than source/span/quote consistency.

remediation.summary: Required non-empty, internally consistent evidence anchors and filtered fabricated spans before claim admission.

findings.remediationHint: Require non-empty quote, ordered offsets, evidence/source binding, and quote equality against the referenced source slice before admission.

findings.title: 1Password skill exposes vault metadata to agent transcripts

validation.rationale: A tracked repo-local 1Password skill still has broad activation and instructions that can emit host/auth diagnostics and vault/item/field/reference metadata into agent transcripts. It does not expose raw secret values but still leaks operational metadata.

remediation.summary: Narrowed the 1Password skill trigger and required approval-gated, metadata-only secret-reference inventory.

findings.remediationHint: Narrow activation, remove default process/account diagnostics, require explicit user approval before inventory, and default to redacted status/counts.

findings.title: Training artifacts disclose local filesystem paths

validation.rationale: Tracked retained training artifacts still contain absolute developer workstation paths. A bounded secret-pattern scan did not identify direct credentials.

remediation.summary: Removed committed training outputs and replaced remaining local path disclosures in retained SkillOpt history files.

findings.remediationHint: Scrub or relativize absolute host paths in retained training artifacts and add sanitizer/export handling for future generated logs and JSON/JSONL records.

findings.title: Path.basename one-argument calls now return a function

validation.rationale: The one-argument basename helper has a correctness/API mismatch, but static search found no maintained production use and the helper is not a security boundary.

findings.remediationHint: No security remediation required. It may be fixed as a normal quality bug separately.

findings.title: Unvalidated PACER report IDs used in cleanup DELETEs

validation.rationale: The PACER driver passes a server-supplied batch report id into cleanup before strict integer decoding, interpolating it into a credentialed same-origin DELETE path. Existing tests assert cleanup for invalid IDs.

remediation.summary: Validated server report IDs before cleanup and prevented DELETE calls for invalid or fractional IDs.

findings.remediationHint: Decode report ID immediately after start, never cleanup using an untrusted raw value, and update tests so invalid IDs fail without cleanup.

findings.title: Static API codemod rewrites shadowed identifiers

validation.rationale: The tracked codemod records relocation targets by const name and rewrites identifiers by text rather than proving reference identity, so shadowed locals or parameters can be rewritten.

remediation.summary: Resolved usage identifiers to the original relocated symbol and expanded shorthand properties without touching shadowed bindings.
verificationCommands: direct in-memory shadowing regression for rewriteStaticApiColocation passed in operator transcript

findings.remediationHint: Collect verified reference nodes before removing declarations or resolve usages to the original symbol; exclude binding/declaration/import/type-only identifiers and add shadowing tests.

findings.title: Unsanitized extract out-label permits path traversal

validation.rationale: Corpus extract accepts an unrestricted output label, joins it into a staging output path, then removes/writes through that computed path without segment validation or root containment for the label.

remediation.summary: Rejected corpus extract labels that are empty, absolute, traversal, contain separators, or contain NUL before staging writes.

findings.remediationHint: Validate out-label as a single safe path segment and resolve the final output directory under the corpus staging root before removal or writes.

findings.title: Research docs leak private repo paths and internals

validation.rationale: Tracked research docs contain developer-local absolute paths and private external-repo implementation metadata. This is passive repo disclosure, not a runtime exploit.

remediation.summary: Scrubbed private checkout, scratch, download, and memory paths from identity-as-IRI research artifacts.

findings.remediationHint: Redact local paths and private repo internals; use repo-relative references or summarized private-repo learnings without concrete private layouts.

findings.title: Exported bin module starts MCP server on import
classes: executable module exported as library subpath

validation.rationale: The package wildcard export makes the bin subpath importable, and src/bin.ts starts the stdio MCP server during module evaluation while exporting configuration.

remediation.summary: Guarded MCP server startup behind import.meta.main and added import-only coverage.

findings.remediationHint: Move reusable config to an import-safe module and keep executable startup behind an entrypoint guard or non-exported launcher; correct package export/sideEffects metadata.

findings.title: Inherited keys accepted as skill names

validation.rationale: A correctness defect exists in local skills tooling, but the reachable impact is local command failure or malformed metadata, not code execution, auth bypass, secret exposure, or cross-boundary access.

findings.remediationHint: No security remediation required. As robustness cleanup, use Map/null-prototype/hasOwn checks for skill names.

findings.title: Removed overrides reintroduce vulnerable Autolinker

validation.rationale: Autolinker exists transitively via markdown-toc, but maintained source uses it only for local Markdown TOC generation, and the checked code path did not invoke Autolinker or serve public HTML.

verificationCommands: rg -n "markdownToc|@effect/markdown-toc|remarkable|autolinker|linkify" package.json bun.lock packages apps docs --glob "!**/.repos/**"

findings.remediationHint: No security remediation required. Optional dependency hygiene can replace markdown-toc or pin/override the transitive dependency.

findings.title: PACER auth sends Option wrappers in login JSON

validation.rationale: PACER auth builds a CsoAuthRequest with Effect Option fields and sends the runtime object directly through bodyJson, serializing option wrappers instead of schema-encoded plain JSON.

remediation.summary: Schema-encoded login/logout request bodies before bodyJson and asserted that Option internals are not serialized.

findings.remediationHint: Encode CsoAuthRequest through schemaBodyJson or S.encode before bodyJson, and assert login request JSON shape in mock/tests.

findings.title: Schema default refactor drops defensive fallbacks

validation.rationale: Malformed plain objects can cause local scratchpad/codegen crashes, but this private scratchpad code has no product/runtime import path or attacker-reachable boundary.

findings.remediationHint: No security remediation required. Optional robustness can normalize helper inputs through schema decoders or restore local fallbacks.

findings.title: Unsafe ontology IRI codegen allows TS code injection

validation.rationale: Tracked scratchpad ontology codegen preserves IRIs as raw strings, derives term keys, and renders term keys/full IRI values directly into generated TypeScript. Reachability is private developer tooling, but the codegen sink is maintained and unsafe.

remediation.summary: Rendered generated object keys and IRI values as safe TypeScript literals and removed a cloned-map bucket path that hid dynamic terms from tests.

findings.remediationHint: Serialize generated object keys and IRI values as safe literals or reject non-identifier terms with strict validation; add codegen regression coverage.

findings.title: UTF-16 lastIndexOf returns code-unit offset

validation.rationale: The UTF-16 offset mismatch is in an installed third-party buffer package, not tracked maintained source, and no maintained source imports the npm buffer polyfill or calls Buffer.lastIndexOf with UTF-16 encodings.

findings.remediationHint: No security remediation required. Track as dependency correctness only if browser Buffer parity matters.

findings.title: Scratchpad logging code fails to compile and can crash

validation.rationale: Scratchpad Logging code imports a missing sibling Identity module, imports a non-exported read error symbol, and references undefined identifiers in the write path. The scratchpad tsconfig includes these files.

remediation.summary: Removed invalid imports, fixed the write path for string/Buffer chunks, and covered rotating log writes.

findings.remediationHint: Fix/remove the identity import, align exported error imports, and rewrite RotatingFileSink.write so all values are scoped and defined.

findings.title: PACER token rotation is not logged out on session release

validation.rationale: Maintained PACER session finalization reads the latest tokenRef before logout, PclClient writes rotated token values into that ref, and tests cover release after rotation.

findings.remediationHint: No remediation needed; keep the regression test.

findings.title: Root utils import now loads Node-only filesystem modules

validation.rationale: Current source and dist outputs removed top-level createRequire/static node:* imports; Node builtins are lazily resolved through guarded process.getBuiltinModule only when Node-specific helpers run.

findings.remediationHint: No remediation needed; keep Node-only helper resolution lazy/guarded.

findings.title: Recharts pie story uses nullable index as a number

validation.rationale: Live Recharts types define the sector index as number, Storybook typecheck passes, and the path is demo-only without a security-sensitive sink.

findings.remediationHint: No security remediation needed. If Recharts widens the index type later, normalize before array lookup.

findings.title: IME Enter guard regression can submit mid-composition

validation.rationale: The Enter key binding documents an IME bail-out but only checks modern composition state before applying default send policy. Legacy IME Enter can dispatch send.

remediation.summary: Restored the legacy IME keyCode 229 bail-out alongside modern composition-state checks.

findings.remediationHint: Restore legacy IME key fallback beside the modern composition guard, preferably via a named helper, with focused coverage.

findings.title: ColorKit copy constructor now aliases mutable state

validation.rationale: The reported ColorKit file and implementation are not present in current HEAD, and git history shows the path was deleted. No maintained ColorKit implementation remains outside finding metadata.

findings.remediationHint: No code change required. If ColorKit returns, clone internal state and add regression coverage.
